run_job_compute: run a JobManager to execute a job runner compute and return a JobResult
process_job_with_lifecycle: process a job through pre_compute, compute, and post_compute lifecycle hooks with error handling
create_job_manager: create a JobManager instance with a JobInfo, AppConfig, and JobRunner for a specific processing step
set_job_crashed: set a job as crashed with an error message and optional cause exception
set_job_exceeded_duration: set a job as exceeded maximum duration with an error message and optional cause
